description: Grateful for the beat, for my family, and for the surgeons, doctors, and ER staff.
title: Grateful
transcript: Grateful. I have a beat. I'm grateful I didn't accept the doctor's diagnosis. I am grateful for my parents. I'm grateful for my sister. I'm grateful for the surgeons. Doctors and the ER staff. I'm grateful.

description: Looking back on year 42, the ups and downs, and what it taught me.
title: Year 42 was a rocky one
transcript: Year 42 was a rocky one. It had its ups and downs, both good and bad. I learned a lot. There was some positive things that happened and some negative things, even some eye-opening things that I've learned a lot from. And just thank you for all the birthday wishes.
